The woman carries a small flag while the camera follows their brisk movement through the wooded area under natural daylight. (2) They arrive at a massive, moss-covered tree that features a vertical white sign with red characters reading "哈哈谷". The woman excitedly points at the sign while the man holds an action camera on a selfie stick to document the moment, their facial expressions showing surprise and joy at the discovery. (3) The scene shifts to the man and woman holding a small red and gold banner with Chinese text, laughing and smiling directly at the camera. The lighting is bright and natural, coming through the tree canopy, and they use their hands to gesture towards the banner and the tree. (4) A third person in a black t-shirt leans over with his back to the camera, and the two hosts perform a fast, rhythmic slapping routine on his back. Large pixelated boxes cover parts of the screen for comedic effect as humorous variety-show text overlays in yellow and blue appear to emphasize the action. (5) The man in the black t-shirt stands up straight, facing the camera with a big smile and glasses, and throws both hands in the air with open palms, shouting "Ha!" in celebration of the completed ritual while the hosts cheer him on from the sides.
